travel.title: TRAVEL
travel.intro: San Juan Island is - well yes, you guessed it - an island! That means it's surrounded by water, so you will either arrive by boat or plane, unless you are an excellent swimmer.

modes.label: WASHINGTON → ANACORTES
modes.body: Most guests will fly into Seattle-Tacoma (SEA), then rent a car, carpool, or take a shuttle north to the ferry terminal in Anacortes. Paine Field (PAE) and Bellingham (BLI) are closer, but tend to have fewer flights—worth checking if they work for you!

modes.label: ANACORTES → FRIDAY HARBOR
modes.body:
We highly recommend taking the ferry (and it's fun!). You can bring your car or park it in Anacortes and walk on - we've done this before and it's very safe. 

If you’re bringing a car, reserve a spot both ways; reservations open up 60-days in advance, and go quick. Set a reminder for June 1st to grab a spot. 

If you're walking on (not bringing a car), you don't need a reservation. You can buy a ticket at the ferry.

modes.label: SEATTLE → FRIDAY HARBOR
modes.body: Skip the drive and ferry with a flight from Seattle directly into Friday Harbor. Faster, more expensive and objectively very cool.

modes.label: ON ISLAND
modes.body: Friday Harbor is very walkable, and we’ll provide transportation to and from the welcome event on Friday and wedding on Saturday. If you want to explore beyond town, bring a car.

travel.stayIntro: We will provide guests with transportation to and from the below locations, so it's highly recommended you stay at one of the following if you are not driving to the venue (ride-share is a crapshoot on the island).
travel.stayPhotoAlt: Open water off San Juan Island

stays.name: FRIDAY HARBOR HOUSE
stays.desc: If you're feeling fancy! This is the nicest of the three, right in town and great views of the harbor.

stays.name: ISLAND INN
stays.desc: Modern and low-key, with more of an apartment vibe vs. hotel.

stays.name: EARTHBOX INN
stays.desc: Casual and a little retro, with an indoor pool and spa!

things.title: THINGS TO DO
things.intro: There is lots to do on the island if you can spare the time!

items.name: WESTCOTT BAY SHELLFISH CO.
items.desc: The best oysters. Pulled straight from the bay and shucked at picnic tables overlooking the water.

items.name: SAN JUAN ISLAND BREWING CO.
items.desc: A big, friendly taproom in the middle of town. Great for beer, cider, and some classic pub food.

items.name: SALTY FOX
items.desc: Our go-to coffee spot with breakfast snacks.

sections.title: ACTIVITIES
sections.photoAlt: A boat crossing the water off San Juan Island

items.name: WHALE WATCHING
items.desc: Could be whale-y fun! Lots of different types of whales hang out near the island, Orcas, humpbacks, etc.

items.name: VISIT ALPACAS
items.desc: Go hang out with some alpacas. Pet them?

sections.title: SIGHTS
sections.photoAlt: A marina in the San Juan Islands

items.name: LIME KILN POINT STATE PARK
items.desc: A lighthouse on the west-side rocks and your best shot at spotting orcas from shore.

items.name: ROCHE HARBOR
items.desc: A historic resort village on the north end of the island. East-coast vibes.

items.name: PELINDABA LAVENDER FARM
items.desc: Fields of lavender in bloom in July! Plus a farm stand of everything-lavender.

items.name: NATIONAL HISTORICAL PARK
items.desc: American Camp and English Camp. Beach walks, prairie trails, and big views at both ends of the island.

items.q: HOW DO I GET TO THE ISLAND?
items.a: A few options! Check out our travel page for more info.

items.q: CAN I WALK FROM THE FERRY TERMINAL TO MY HOTEL?
items.a: Yep, if you're staying at one of our recommended hotels. All three are under a 0.5 mile walk and relatively flat.

For our Friday welcome event, we're shooting for 'Western Elegance,' bolo ties & cowboy boots encouraged.
For our Saturday wedding, we're doing Black Tie Optional. Inspo here.

items.q: HOW DO I GET TO THE VENUE?
items.a: We will be providing transportation from downtown Friday Harbor for both Friday and Saturday. Otherwise, you will need to drive and park the venue.
